items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: When I was taking lessons from him.

ctx.x: Palace Theatre. What band was he playing with at the time? Do you remember that?
I just remember his band, but, uh, he was playing at the Palace Theatre. Uh-huh. And at the Lyric Theatre, Mr. Vic Gaffert used to play at the Lyric Theatre. Do you remember that, Hal?
Black Benny on drum. Black Benny on drum. Yeah.
